notes.title: Map loading speed increased by 432%
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44645977/0389999bc853c123e904ce68dd3a8e1b5663f00d.png[/img]

Thank you all so much for your continued patience. I believe that the slow map writing and loading speed has been tormenting all players for a long time.

Now I finally found a way to solve this problem. The current map writing speed requires no waiting. The loading speed is also increased by 432%.

After this update, the original map archive cannot be loaded, but the more important player archives are not affected. In summary, considering that there are not many players currently affected, the update is pushed directly.


[b]Update[/b]

1 Map loading speed increased by 432%

2. Map document reading and writing speed increased by 210%

4 Adjust dungeon loading in stages

5 Fixed the bug of missing dungeon entrance wall

[b]Plan[/b]

After working for a long time, I found that my biggest weakness is drawing.

And because I don’t have a design draft, I often lose my way in the process of game development.

So, in the next period of time, I will give priority to drawing all the monster drafts one by one. Add them to the game. Then write a lot of code for the game characters.

In other words, you may not be able to play the monsters that will be added next. However, when all the monsters are drawn, I will add the code uniformly. Then you can play freely.
